findings.finding: Submitting edited search before the 300 ms debounce selects the previous query result.
findings.impact: Entering Busan and pressing Enter immediately selects Seoul and persists the wrong favorite.
findings.reproduction: Fresh browser at /; wait for initial catalog, fill 지역 검색 with 부산, press Enter immediately. Observed /weather/seoul/hourly and heading 서울.
findings.requirement: AC2; specification primary search journey and stable selection
findings.confidence: high; actual Chromium with actual demo BFF
findings.disposition: Must Fix: bind submission to the submitted search value, or defer until matching query results exist.

findings.finding: A delayed geolocation callback invokes select with stale captured state and overwrites subsequently added favorites.
findings.impact: User favorites are silently lost; the stale whole-state replacement can also restore older preferences.
findings.reproduction: Fresh browser; hold getCurrentPosition callback; click 현재 위치; select 부산; then return Seoul coordinates. After the React persistence effect, places changes from [busan] to [seoul]. Locations page contains only Seoul.
findings.requirement: AC2/AC3; async ownership and stable favorites in product specification and technical design
findings.confidence: high; actual Chromium, controlled geolocation callback, real reverse lookup to local demo BFF
findings.disposition: Must Fix: update against current state and reject/cancel obsolete location/search completions as appropriate.

findings.finding: Snapshot validation accepts absent/non-finite save timestamps and structurally malformed Weather objects.
findings.impact: The documented 24-hour bound is bypassed and corrupted local cache can replace the entire application with the React Router error page.
findings.reproduction: Populate Seoul snapshot; in isolated browser IndexedDB delete savedAt and set fetchedAt to 2020, then go offline and reload: weather still displays. Change weather.hourly to null and reload offline: Unexpected Application Error / Cannot read properties of null (reading filter).
findings.requirement: AC5; specification storage-corruption recovery and technical design 24-hour offline expiry
findings.confidence: high; actual Chromium IndexedDB, actual offline service-worker shell and demo BFF snapshot
findings.disposition: Must Fix: validate finite bounded savedAt plus required nested weather shape; safely discard invalid records and keep the app usable.

main_reported_followup.finding: Nation adapter uses regionName before cityName, collapsing distinct city display names; main reports fixture evidence.
main_reported_followup.independent_status: Source priority independently visible; live fixture reproduction not independently performed in QA-1. Include corrected city identity in later verification.

limitations: No independent rebuild: browser used existing production bundle prepared by main; source manifest verified before/after.
No real network/provider, push-device, deployment, Docker/Compose or remote CI execution.
No cross-browser or iOS/Android installed-device matrix.
No dynamic previous-worker upgrade/rollback test; only existing worker source review and offline fresh-install execution.
Concurrent snapshot pruning was inspected but not deterministically reproduced; no finding asserted.
Initial snapshot probe was interrupted by first-worker controllerchange navigation; repeat after activation produced stable reproduction.
Initial geolocation log sampled before the React persistence effect; confirmation waits for effects and reads location cards.
release_assessment: Local integration scope is substantial but has three Must Fix defects. Full mobile parity remains incomplete as declared: conditional weather alerts, real push receipt, provider/world/air freshness, native commercial/widget policy, supported-device/browser matrix and hosting approval remain release gates. Do not close #2558 or claim full parity.
